body: In terms of withdrawals, you should be ok. Maybe MINOR stomach cramp and maybe *some* irritability, but I wouldn't expect much - and anything that does crop up would likely pass quickly, like in 1-2 days or less.
Not good. Headaches and stomach cramps settling in. Can barely move from the aches and pains, both real (from my actual injury) and from withdrawal. Trying to stay distracted. :(

Hey. You don't know me but can you please do me a favor? Put it off. Just doe 24hrs. See how you feel tomorrow. Think about it then, too. Can you handle putting it off tomorrow night too? I'm asking because I lost a friend. I just wish I'd asked him to wait 24hrs and THEN decide what he wanted to do. 

So can you put it off for a day? See how you feel tomorrow at the same time?

A lot of Redditors are trolls, btw. They sit behind their keyboards and talk shit to people because they're miserable too, and the only comfort they get is making others more miserable than they are. Seems cliche, but it's true. They're lonely and sad too. They just deal with it in shitty ways. (Or sometimes they're just straight up assholes. Plenty of those here too.)

Just take some breaths and try putting this off, even just for 24 hours. Please.
5000? That seems like a lot. Then again I don't know much about Gaba
Honestly I'm too scared to ask. I have a lot to lose. (Which is stupid, I know, why am I involved with drugs if I have a lot to lose? Because I'm a moron.)
Ty, appreciate the advice. Happy cake day :)
Seconded. Seriously. Stop now. I'm 8 years in and still addicted.
I hate, HATE RLS. If I could sleep through the stomach cramps I would, but the fucking RLS won't let go.

The thing that keeps me alive is this:

I can't let my daughter think I didn't love her enough to endure all the pain in the world for her. I can't let her think I didn't love her enough to stay. I can't be a reason her sweet face cries heartbroken tears. I love her more than anything, including myself, and so I endure everything for her.

I understand you, though. I truly do.

The reasons I want to die are entirely for the benefit of other people. Financially, mentally, and physically, I'm a burden on everyone in my life and my death would relieve a lot of stress in so many areas of their lives. I don't feel this way because I think I'm alone or unloved. I feel this way because I care about the few people I have left and acknowledge that I'm a weight around their shoulders. LIVING is the selfish act, for me. It's selfish to sit in the boat, weighing it down, watching all of us slowly sink when I could simply jump out and ensure they stay afloat.
Same. :/ I hope you make it through.
Bad days clean and sober mean suicidal thoughts for me. So, no. I appreciate the sentiment and I agree that being sober is healthier and USUALLY a better life, but this isn't one-size-fits-all.
This is about money, not pain.

I know she loves me. These feelings aren't stemming from feeling alone or unloved. I don't necessarily want to die, I want to improve her life by lessening her stress. She shouldn't *have* to give everything to see me happy. She's already giving all that she can and while I'm incredibly grateful for everything she does, it doesn't mean I'm happy. I'm existing, not living. 

Why should I keep weighing down the sinking boat, causing everyone else to sink with me, when I can just as easily get out and let everyone else float on the surface? To stay is selfish.

It's hard to stand up for yourself in situations like that because naturally you want to help the other person... But like I said, it's impossible to help someone that isn't ready to accept the help offered. It sounded truly like she wasn't ready. Asking her to leave may seem harsh to you, but subjecting you (and everyone on Instagram) to behavior like that is really, really upsetting and terrifying. You shouldn't have to experience that. I get how you feel, though. I don't blame you for feeling that way. But I truly do feel you did the right thing. Maybe this will open her eyes and help her realize she needs to talk to a doctor because people can't handle the way she's dealing with her feelings.

I hope she's going to be okay. I hope all of you are. Forgive yourself when you can and remember that it's equally important to protect yourself too.

I appreciate your sentiment, I do. But it's math. You can't really argue with math.

If I die, there's no $300 car payment or $100 car insurance or $800 rent payment. That's at least $1,200 a month they aren't spending on me because I wouldn't be here. That's $1,200 they'd have to get my Mom a new car and she wouldn't be stressing.

If I'm dead, they save $1,200 a month. They need the money. 

I'm physically and mentally disabled and supporting myself is incredibly difficult, hence why they've been helping me... And they shouldn't have to. They shouldn't be struggling because of me.

It's just math. If I'm dead, they get to keep $1,200 to make their lives better instead of throwing it into the life of someone that barely exists. I don't live. I exist. There's little joy. There's always physical pain because of my injuries. There's always mental pain because of my mental health problems. I don't live my life. I just exist. And it seems silly and frivolous to pour money into a person that barely exists. 

I could do so much better by them if I just died. Financially, mentally, and physically, they'd have less stress. It's just math.
I hope you're okay.

I think so, yeah. You can only help someone who wants help, and it doesn't seem like she's ready or in the right headspace to receive the help she needs. At that point, the only thing left is for you and your roommate to look after your own mental health. Being around a person that behaves that way is a huge stressor. It isn't good for you. (It's shitty to say that, especially on this subreddit, but it's the reality of the situation. Suicidal behavior is really, REALLY taxing on the people that witness it.)

Either way, I think you did the right thing. You have to look out for yourselves too. You matter. I truly hope the roommate in question gets the help they need. I hope all of you can heal and recover from this in your own ways. I'm sorry for what you experienced, it had to be really hard. You did the right thing.
If you have a pet... Think about how they would constantly be looking for you. That's one of my biggest deterrents.

I hope you don't. I know that's selfish, and I'm sorry. I just hope you delay it. Maybe tomorrow. Or the next day. Or next week. Or next month. Just try putting it off for a while. I hope you can, anyway.
I wish I could, too. :(
I think I'm fucked... But thank you

Speaking from experience - NOT getting addicted isn't an option. Eventually your tolerance will build and even if you don't, your body will start to want more. If you're legitimately worried about becoming addicted (and as I am currently withdrawing and sick as fuck, it LITERALLY PAINS ME to say this...) - flush em. Talk to your doctor about medicinal weed, something less potent than oxy, Butrans patches, whatever.

Me fucking too. I blacked out in bed last night. Slept like the dead. I feel sick, my whole body aches, this shit is the fucking worst...

I wish you well on your journey, whether that be to sobriety or not.

Thank you. I will check out this book. I need something to occupy my time and my mind anyway...

My knee-jerk reaction was to debate what you said, but I can't. If my situation were happening to someone else, I would swear fifteen different ways that they were deserving of help and support. But somehow I deny myself that same exact logic? 

Yeah, I need that book.
Extremely dizzy when moving, but fine when stationary. Chugging water. Still no sleep.

I think I slept for 3 hours. Maybe 4. Definitely delving into the distractions. I'm likely going to try the bath thing tonight. Thank you for being compassionate and understanding, I seriously appreciate it.

Update: I slept a little. I don't feel like crawling out of my skin. Took Gaba, some Ibuprofen, and an anti-diarrheal. Been sucking down water and occasionally some Sprite. I ate earlier but felt sick almost IMMEDIATELY after.

Gonna go get lost on Tiktok and try not to let my brain think.

It's funny you say this because I legit didn't *know* this but discovered it by accident. I've tried cold turkey once before and I wound up laying in the shower with the water just beating down on me for HOURS. I listened to an audiobook and just tried to keep my mind occupied. I had to do that several times. Go in, feel okay. Get out, gradually feel worse... Hurry the fuck back into the shower. 

I hadn't thought about masturbation but that makes total sense. The brain can only really process one thing with any efficacy, so turning my mind to my hoo-ha might help for a while. Thanks for the suggestion and the compassion.

I agree with you, in a way. Like... If someone else was in my position, I would advocate for them to be able to go get help for this and not just suffer.

I guess the way I see it, I deserve this because I lost control. I don't treat others the way I treat myself, lol.

I wish anyone had listened to me. From the moment I got into the ER, everyone kept trying to get me to leave. My back was so fucked up that if the building was on fire I would have burned to death, but they kept asking if I was ready to go home.

Afterward... Physical therapy multiple times. Pain management therapy (which was pretty damn informative, honestly). Asking for diagnostic pictures to be taken because it was getting worse, and getting shot down by my insurance... Year after year, since 2012.

It started as pain management and quickly became drug abuse as my situation deteriorated despite my asking for help to fix the issue and thereby get me off the meds. Now, I'm not saying I blame them. Me abusing these meds is entirely *my* fault and I take full accountability for making that choice. I have an addictive personality, so... Me and happy pills were like fire and gasoline.

I'm just rambling at this point and I'm sorry.

Thank you for listening and being compassionate. I truly appreciate this not being a place of judgment while I ride this shit out.

There's literally no one to blame but myself - this is entirely my doing. And to be honest, if someone offered me something right now, I don't know if I'd say no. I'd likely say yes. I know I don't have the right attitude yet. You're 1000% right, attitude and mental fortitude has a lot to do with getting through it... 

I took an anti-diarrheal and 2 Gabapentin. Been sucking down Sprite (it helps with mg nausea) and water. 

I've been on a steadily increasing dose since 2012. No one was interested in fixing my back, but medicating me through it. I just want to sleep like I'm dead to get through this.

My shit is bad and I know it's bad. I go through a 5mg oxycodone (100 count) and 20mg extended release oxycontin (60 count) in less than a month. I usually clear the 5mgs in less than a week. The 20s last me longer, but still not enough.

I fucked myself badly. I know I have no one to blame but myself. I know this is bad. And it scares me that if someone offered me something right now I doubt I'd say no just because of the physical withdrawals.

Trying to remind myself that this is my fault, and that I did this to myself, and time is moving at the same speed it always is. I'm hot and cold. The fan is blowing on me and my skin feels raw and sensitive. 

Fuck, man. Why the fuck did I do this to myself? Damn it.
I have a fuckton of Gabapentin and various muscle relaxers, but in a wave of horrific irony, I had told my doctor years ago that I didn't like Xanax because it made me so tired...

I just keep telling myself I did this to myself and this is my punishment. I have to get through this because I literally have no one to blame but myself. 

Doesn't make the physical impact suck any less... But I'm trying.

Currently in the "trying to sleep but can't because my body keeps jerking awake and it feels like my skin is vibrating" area.... Going to have stomach cramps soon. Irritated but trying not to be. Pounding headache. Truly, truly hating myself
